name: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression
summary: Lar Prowltusk has uncovered a plan to strike Durotar's settlements and Orgrimmar. The Kolkar centaurs have divided the invasion plans among three leaders at Kolkar Crag, west of Sen'jin Village.

sections.title: A Looming Invasion
sections.body: Lar Prowltusk is a troll tracker scouting western Durotar. Under cover of night, he slipped into Kolkar Crag and found the Kolkar centaurs preparing more than scattered coastal raids. Three leaders hold the invasion plans. Their targets are the Valley of Trials, Sen'jin Village, and the gates of Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Striking the Canyons
sections.body: The Kolkar leaders hold three attack scrolls in their camps in the dry canyons of Kolkar Crag. You are sent to destroy the scrolls before the centaurs can strike. Lar Prowltusk believes the Horde could defeat a full invasion, but burning the plans can spare Durotar's defenders costly fighting as their young nation finds its footing.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Thwarting Kolkar Aggression?
faq.answer: Lar Prowltusk, a Darkspear troll scout, offers the work just outside Sen'jin Village, along Durotar's southern bluffs.

faq.q: What targets are the Kolkar centaur planning to attack?
faq.answer: The Kolkar plans name the Valley of Trials, Sen'jin Village, and Orgrimmar as targets.
Kolkar Crag lies west of Sen'jin Village, beyond the rocky ridges in southern Durotar.

faq.q: Where are the attack plans found inside the crag?
faq.answer: Three Kolkar leaders hold the invasion scrolls at campsites throughout the crag.

faq.q: Why do the Kolkar want to invade Durotar?
faq.answer: The Kolkar are an aggressive centaur clan native to Kalimdor's dry lands. They see the arriving orcs and Darkspear trolls as intruders on their territory and hunting grounds.

faq.q: What happens after the plans are destroyed?
faq.answer: Destroying the plans disrupts the Kolkar's coordinated attack and protects Durotar's settlements from a sudden siege.

angles.text: Stopping the Kolkar offensive spares the young Horde an exhausting fight on several fronts at the threshold of its new home.
As a Darkspear troll, you know Sen'jin Village cannot fall to a centaur attack after your people lost their ancient island home.
As an orc, you know the Valley of Trials is where young orcs undergo their rites of adulthood. Centaur aggression there insults orcish warrior culture.
